reason: Provides automatic image understanding for a text-oriented DeepSeek Harness agent through OCR, layout, semantic, and visual analysis using cloud or local vision backends.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本智能体提供自动图片识别能力，支持通过云端兼容 API 或本地 Ollama 返回 OCR、布局、语义和视觉分析结果。
summaries.en: Adds automatic image understanding for text-oriented agents, returning OCR, layout, semantic, and visual analysis through a cloud-compatible API or local Ollama backend.

capabilities: Analyzes images from local paths or network URLs
Sends image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API or local Ollama backend
Registers a vision analysis tool and wrapped model provider
